name: Rye Brook Teen Travel Camp
operator_name: Village of Rye Brook Parks & Recreation
description_short: Village trip camp for teens, six weeks from July 6 to August 14, 2026, with a different outing most days, such as Dorney Park, Splashdown, Mountain Creek Waterpark, Quassy, the Maritime Aquarium and bowling.
notes: Non-resident rates shown. Residents pay $855 for one week up to $3,630 for six weeks, or $3,480 for six weeks if registered before May 1.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Teen Travel Camp page: 2026 camp July 6 through August 14; forms due June 26; questions to bbecker@ryebrookny.gov. ZIP is from the Recreation office address in the sidebar (938 King Street, Rye Brook, NY 10573); the page does not say where trips leave from. Session price is the non-resident 6 week rate from the fee page.

Researched by Claude from this page. Travel Camp Fee Schedule 2026, 6th to 10th grades. Non-resident: 1 week $1,005 up to 6 weeks $4,230. Residents after 5/1: $855 a week up to $3,630; before 5/1: $3,480 for six weeks. Ages derived from grades.

Researched by Claude from this page. Teen Travel Camp Trips: 2026 trip calendar from July 6 (swim test and BBQ), including Urban Air, a Westchester Soccer Club game, Dorney Park, Dave & Busters, Splashdown, Mountain Creek, Maritime Aquarium, Quassy, Bowlero and Brownstone.

source.title: Teen Travel Camp, Village of Rye Brook

for_andrew: Grades: the 2026 fee schedule says 6th to 10th, the village FAQ says 7th to 10th. Recorded 6th to 10th from the fee schedule. Which is right?
